_about: Every table in the two libSQL databases, with how it stays bounded or why it may grow (read from the live sqlite_master on Nov 25 2026). kind: record (kept on purpose: it IS the data), mirror (holds what its source publishes), derived (rebuilt from other tables), pruned (deleted past a horizon), retired (to be dropped). scripts/test_table_retention.py holds it against the code.
